verdicts.reason: A is just a smaller copy of the original. The body copy, the 'Reserve a Case' label and the legal line are too small to read at this size, and the bottom third of the canvas is empty cream. B was actually rearranged into two columns, but the body copy is cut off at the top: it starts mid-sentence at 'by hand in our', with its opening lost behind a dark header band that runs only partway across. The logo is oversized and competes with the headline, the CTA is tiny, and the right column is crammed while space is unbalanced. A at least keeps every message intact and in order, so it is the less broken of the two.
